query: I added a music bed under my talking-head video at the volume the docs recommended and now the music is louder than me. What went wrong?
expected_behavior: explain that published defaults assume a normalized voiceover around -16 LUFS while raw footage can sit near -26
give the ebur128 command to measure both
derive the gain from the measured difference instead of suggesting a new fixed number
warn that raising the voice later invalidates every derived gain
notes: A default of 0.30 put the bed on top of a -26 LUFS phone take.
